technical_decision: Stop safety-only prompt tuning. Reuse existing Workers AI standard messages/text API for bounded read-only answering instead of forcing classification function calls. No framework/model/credential/binding change.
changes: Generic contextual conjunction/correction fragments and non-action interrogatives qualify for inert read-only advice; explicit action vocabulary keeps existing action gates. No named model/fixture phrase rule.
Read-only provider request sends exact native user/assistant turns and latest exact user input; retrieved evidence is separate and labeled.
Read-only calls offer no tools; nonempty bounded provider text is retained, never parsed as route/permission/project/proposal.
Existing action classification, deterministic ambiguity, approvals, reviewed-SHA and write/reread gates retained.
Acceptance runner separately verifies provider-delivered roles/turns and corrects pre_dispatch stage when inference already completed.
